items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: The transcript mentions Sonny Rollins only in the interviewer's question listing artists Henry Grimes recorded with. The interviewee (Rashied Ali) does not respond to confirm a personal relationship with Rollins, nor does he mention Rollins in his own turns.

ctx.x: Bassist/violinist Henry Grimes was born in Philadelphia on November 3, 1935.

He was in constant demand throughout the 1950s and 60s and recorded with Tony Scott, Gerry Mulligan, Sonny Rollins and numerous other artists. He became an integral part of the free jazz movement in New York before leaving music for three decades. His reentry into the jazz world in 2003 was a major event and has proven highly productive.
Rashied and Henry were interviewed in Clinton, New York on 1/30/09 before a duo concert at Hamilton, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
